kits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: simple abstract mascot for Fusion AI Kits productivity app. Create ONE very simple original NON-ANIMAL character in the same family as an approved plain blue rounded blob with two dark oval eyes, a tiny mouth, two stub arms and two short feet. Simple friendly app-mascot abstraction, original design, do not copy existing brand characters. Smooth matte flat colored shapes with only subtle soft 3D volume. NOT realistic, no fur, plush fibers, shiny large eyes, baby proportions or elaborate rendering. Two small flat dark oval eyes, one tiny understated mouth. Entire character is one simple geometric body with short integrated arms and two stub feet; no separate complex head. ABSOLUTELY NO ANIMAL FEATURES: no ears, horns, snout, beak, wings, fins, tail, feathers or recognizable species. No clothing, accessories, headphones, armor, props, chest panels, logos, words or watermark. Full body front view, square canvas, same standing baseline, 15% empty margin, complete feet visible. Genuine transparent alpha background including gaps, no checkerboard, scenery, floor, cast shadow, outline glow, halo or stray particles. Restrained charm and clear tiny-icon readability. Subject below determines DIFFERENT geometric silhouette, color and expression; do not merely recolor the same body.
Subject: A tall softly rounded vertical pill body, cobalt-blue with a subtle cyan edge, small upright oval eyes, tiny relaxed smile, very short low side arms. Body distinctly taller than the main rounded-square Fusion blob.
